nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Fishblitz development guide for AI agents: the eight design-philosophy principles (no villains/bad luck, restoration-as-adaptation, Presences kept ambiguous, narrative through play, biased storytelling, costly resources, slow community return, season-driven drama), agent communication style, C# code style conventions (PascalCase, _camelCase fields, ReactiveUnity Reactive<T> properties, Logger, NUnit asserts), common Unity patterns (RequireComponent, coroutines, Input System OnMove), tech stack notes (URP, Cinemachine, BlueOyster JSON saves, custom shaders), a complete FlyingChaser prefab setup recipe, and pointers to agent skill docs (issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs).

nodes.name: IDEAS.md
nodes.summary: Design source of truth for Fishblitz. Defines the premise (player arrives in an abandoned, season-organized region and repairs it, villagers return, a disaster hits each season) and opening sequence; themes (no bad people, only bad luck, living within limits, community drama of adaptation and repair); the deliberately ambiguous Presences (River, Forest, Winter) and storytelling rules (brief dialogue, audio-overlay for long content, environment reinforces story). Details the Way North river progression with bow-and-arrow combat and stealth, the full Trail of the Brother backstory (Patrick, June, Maron, the River Presence, the player), and gameplay systems: mushroom foraging with mix-and-match traits, diet/stamina bars, box rewards (wheelbarrow/bow/crouch), birding via ScriptableObjects, drought and four transition seasons, Three Sisters farming, fire system, and fire ecology wood types.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview: Fishblitz is a top-down pixel art RPG that began as a game-jam fishing game and grew into an expansive RPG, with a link to an early demo on itch.io. Lists the core gameplay loop (fell trees, split firewood, light fires, sleep, fish, go birding) and a short 'what I've learned' section covering Unity/C# experience, design patterns, physics, shaders, and AI.

nodes.name: TODOS.md
nodes.summary: Working task list for immediate development. Tracks this-session tasks (bow/arrow/box SFX, wheelbarrow spawn VFX, done wheelbarrow rolling SFX and CanyonStart spawner), this-week art/design tasks (rocks as cliffs with moss and a mossy golem, carrying/knockback damage rules, enemy sprites for flying chaser, golem rock-thrower, shooter, and slow ground chaser), a rendering task about text sprites from a character set, and a blockers section.

edges.description: IDEAS.md is the design source of truth; AGENTS.md explicitly delegates detail to it while distilling the design philosophy into guiding principles.
Both are project-level overview docs; AGENTS.md documents the dev guide and tech stack while README.md gives the game's high-level pitch and demo link.
README's core gameplay loop (tree felling, fire, fishing, birding) mirrors systems detailed in IDEAS.md.
README's 'Things to do' gameplay loop is tracked operationally in TODOS.md's immediate task list.
